a5e4696e5774476d.description: About Lucid At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility. Position Overview Sr. Electrical Engineer, Inverter is responsible for design intent assembly requirements of Inverter Power Electronics & associated EOL test specifications. Responsible for root cause analysis of product issues, interim containment action development/verification/implementation, & permanent corrective action development/verification/implementation where applicable with close collaboration with core engineering to ensure design intent & validation requirements are met. Key Responsibilities Solve complex component/system level problems using standard problem-solving techniques for inverter power electronics & associated software interface Data driven proactive problem solving, root cause analysis & issue avoidance due to process deviations or critical part quality issues Establish technical depth to troubleshoot all Inverter Power Electronics components and associated interface EOL test equipment/test specifications Responsible for design intent assembly requirements for Inverter Power Electronics assembly & associated enforcement on the line in close collaboration with cross-functional teams Support new product launches, execute part concession deviations for Inverter Power Electronics & associated test specification in the manufacturing plant Support high volume production ramp activities pertaining to product engineering activities Advice on build process development and possible improvements for high volume production lines Lead product change management to address known product compatibility issues for high volume production or known product design issues in production in close collaboration with cross-functional teams where appropriate Skills Structured product problem-solving and root cause analysis using industry-standard techniques Advanced data analysis using statistical methods and tools such as Minitab, JMP, Python, and MATLAB Technical expertise in Inverter Power Electronics, including associated interfaces and troubleshooting Expertise in analog and digital electronic circuits Proficiency with laboratory equipment, including oscilloscopes, signal generators, probes, power analyzers, and DC/AC power supplies Knowledge of electromagnetic compatibility and Power Electronics functional testing Knowledge of communication protocols and associated troubleshooting Proficiency in DFMEA, PFMEA, Control Plans, DVP&R, DFM/DFA, and RCA Proficiency with Atlassian tools, including Jira and Confluence Strong communication, cross-functional collaboration, and technical documentation skills Minimum Qualifications Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline with 5+ years of automotive experience in vehicle attribute design and release, or a Master of Science degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline with 6+ years of relevant automotive experience Prior experience in a resident product engineering role within a manufacturing plant Experience in the development or improvement of Power Electronics products Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification Engineering-in-Training (EIT) certification or certification in engineering fundamentals Collegiate FSAE, BAJA, or similar experience is preferred Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off. Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans. Equal Opportunity: At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at TA-Operations lucidmotors.com. This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website. Candidate Data Privacy: By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. To all recruitment agencies: Lucid Motors does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Lucid Motors. Lucid Motors is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

a5c2d28571dbe53a.description: المسؤوليات: - تقديم تجربة تسوق مميزة للعملاء من خلال مساعدتهم في اختيار الملابس الطبية المناسبة، وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات مع الحفاظ على تنظيم وجاذبية المعرض. المهمات: فتح المعرض واستقبال العملاء والترحيب بهم وتقديم خدمة احترافية. فهم احتياجات العملاء وتقديم المنتجات المناسبة (سكراب، معاطف طبية، إكسسوارات). استلام العهد الموكل لكم وفق اختصاص عملكم بالمعرض. شرح مميزات المنتجات من حيث الجودة، الخامات، والمقاسات. تحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة من قبل الإدارة. عرض المنتجات بطريقة جذابة بعد كويها والمحافظة على ترتيب ونظافة المعرض. ترتيب غرفة تبديل الملابس واعادة الملابس منها بشكل مرتب بمكانها المخصص. متابعة توفر المنتجات وإبلاغ الإدارة عند وجود نقص. المشاركة في عمليات الجرد وتنظيم المخزون. استخدام نظام نقاط البيع لإتمام عمليات البيع. التعامل مع عمليات الاستبدال والاسترجاع وفق سياسة المعرض. تنفيذ جميع السياسات والإجراءات المطلوبة. اللباقة واحترام العميل واستخدام المرونة في التعامل. تنفيذ كل ما يوكل لك وفق اختصاص العمل بالمعرض. يتم تسليم واستلام العهد النقدية بين الشفتات من خلال تعبئة نموذج Cash Handover (ورقة تسليم الكاش) لضمان دقة التسليم والاستلام. يتم إيداع المبالغ النقدية بشكل أسبوعي (يوم الأحد) عن طريق مشرف الفرع. يتم التوقيع على نموذج عهدة الصندوق عند استلام العهدة، لضمان وضوح المسؤولية المالية. بيئة العمل: العمل بنظام الفترات (Shift). الوقوف لفترات طويلة. التعامل المباشر مع العملاء بشكل يومي. التنقل بين الفروع والمناوبة فيها عند الحاجة. ساعات العمل: - 8 ساعات في اليوم، 6 أيام في الأسبوع بحسب الجدولة العمل في فروع المظهر الطبي إما في فرع السليمانية بلازا أو طريق الأمير سلطان أو جدة بارك مول حسب الإحتياج

a5e2af7d38fe10a8.description: Job description This position is for building, deploying and evaluating Client's Arabic AI tutor for mathematics and computer science: preparing Arabic training data, fine-tuning, aligning and evaluating LLMs on Shaheen III and Ibex, and integrating the tutor into the learning platform for a pilot in at least 10 Saudi schools. The position is part of the RDIA-funded project 5870, “An AI-Powered Arabic Tutoring Platform for STEM Education in the Kingdom.” Two engineers will be hired into this role. Key Responsibilities Prepare Arabic training datasets from educational materials and consented platform interactions. Fine-tune, align, and evaluate commercial and open-source LLMs using Shaheen III and Ibex computing platforms. Develop Arabic STEM benchmarks, preference-training methods, and student-safety guardrails. Integrate AI tutoring capabilities into the learning platform, including Arabic right-to-left interfaces. Deploy and optimize models for reliable, low-latency real-time interactions. Support school pilot implementation, evaluation, and teacher feedback collection. Ensure student data privacy and compliance with Saudi data protection requirements. Contribute to research publications, technical reports, and project deliverables. Qualifications & Experience MSc in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field; alternatively, a BSc with at least one year of relevant experience. Hands-on experience in LLM fine-tuning, evaluation, and AI application deployment. Professional proficiency in Arabic and English. Experience with RLHF/DPO, educational technology, or mathematics/programming education is preferred. Technical Skills Advanced Python and PyTorch. Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, and TRL. Distributed GPU training using DeepSpeed or FSDP. LLM evaluation, reward modeling, and preference optimization. Arabic NLP, data pipelines, and OCR. Model serving and inference optimization using tools such as vLLM. APIs, Docker, Git, CI/CD, and production deployment. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

a52787f0a9cd5785.description: About the Role Jezoor General Trading &contracting Company is seeking an HR & Administration Officer to join its team in Al Khobar. This full-time role involves managing daily HR administration, maintaining employee records, and coordinating various office administrative tasks. The position requires 3-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Role Context The HR & Administration Officer will ensure smooth HR operations and efficient office management. This role involves close collaboration with the Finance department for payroll inputs and with the Government Relations Officer to ensure timely completion of employee-related government processes and compliance with Saudi Labor Law. Key Responsibilities Maintain accurate employee files, employment contracts, personnel records, and HR documentation. Coordinate recruitment activities, including interview scheduling, offer management, onboarding, orientation, and offboarding processes. Track attendance, leave, absences, employee entitlements, and contract/permit renewal dates. Prepare and verify monthly payroll inputs, including approved attendance, leave, overtime, and deductions, for processing by the Finance department. Coordinate with the Government Relations Officer on relevant Saudi government portals and employee documentation, including Qiwa, GOSI, Mudad, and Muqeem where applicable. Support compliance with Saudi Labor Law, internal HR policies, and company procedures; escalate sensitive matters to management. Administer performance-review schedules, probation reviews, employee requests, and HR correspondence. Oversee general office administration, including supplies, records management, vendor coordination, and day-to-day administrative needs. Maintain HR reports, trackers, and dashboards; recommend improvements to HR processes and documentation. Handle confidential employee information professionally and with discretion. Required Experience A minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in an HR and administration role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia, within a real estate company setting. The role requires a proactive and organized individual capable of managing multiple responsibilities efficiently. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

a5834c64a26495ce.description: About the Role UrbaCon Contracting & Trading Company is seeking a Senior Cost Control Manager to oversee conceptual estimating, budget development, cost planning, and value management. This full-time position is central to managing company-wide cost plans, monitoring project expenditures, and ensuring financial reporting aligns with management directives. Role Overview The Senior Cost Control Manager will be responsible for the comprehensive oversight of cost control functions across the company's projects. This includes tracking, forecasting, and collecting cost data to ensure conformity with budget directives and providing accurate financial reporting to senior management. The role involves leading a team and implementing robust cost control systems. Key Responsibilities Lead the development and management of comprehensive budgets for large-scale projects and departments, ensuring alignment with organizational goals. Supervise the preparation of detailed cost estimates, incorporating potential risks and ensuring accuracy. Oversee the continuous tracking of project expenditures, ensuring they stay within budget and addressing any deviations. Conduct thorough analysis of cost variances, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions. Prepare and present detailed financial reports to senior management, highlighting key metrics, trends, and potential issues. Identify financial risks associated with projects and develop strategies to mitigate them, ensuring financial stability. Review and manage complex contracts, ensuring compliance with financial terms and resolving any cost-related disputes. Implement and maintain advanced cost control systems and processes to enhance financial oversight and efficiency. Communicate effectively with project managers, finance teams, and senior executives, ensuring alignment on financial objectives and strategies. Lead and mentor a team of cost control professionals, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and financial discipline. Support the implementation of HSE initiatives, participate in safety awareness activities, and contribute to incident reporting and resolution in alignment with company and IMS policies. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 8-10 years of experience in cost control, financial management, or a related field. Demonstrated experience in conceptual estimating, budget development, and cost planning for large-scale projects. Proven ability to manage and analyze complex financial data and reports. Work Environment This is a full-time position within UrbaCon Contracting & Trading Company, requiring a commitment to financial discipline and effective team leadership. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

a58791c562f2cdc6.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب فضاء للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقه في بريدة، القصيم. يركز هذا الدور على تصميم المباني الجديدة وتعديل القائمة منها، بالإضافة إلى تقديم المشورة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات والمساعدة في الإشراف على أعمال الإنشاءات. هذه فرصة للمهندسين المعماريين ذوي الخبرة الحديثة للانضمام إلى بيئة عمل احترافية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم المباني الجديدة أو الملحقات أو التعديلات على المباني القائمة. تقديم المشورة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات القديمة والمحافظة عليها. المساعدة في اختيار الموقع ومباشرة أعمال الإنشاءات. وضع التصاميم لمشاريع الإنشاءات وإدارة فريق التصميم في اختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات. إعداد نماذج بالحجم الطبيعي والرسومات والنماذج الرقمية. المساعدة في اختيار المقاولين والمواد اللازمة للمشاريع. تقديم الدعم لمشروعات الإنشاء ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قِبل المقاول. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. القدرة على تصميم المباني وتعديلها. معرفة بأساليب ترميم الممتلكات والمحافظة عليها. نوع العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مكتب فضاء للاستشارات الهندسية بمدينة بريدة، القصيم. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف.

a5cfedb2bfb30a97.description: About the Role Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare is seeking an ENT Specialist to join their team in Al Qatif. This full-time position involves practicing clinical Otorhinolaryngology, providing routine and emergency diagnostic and therapeutic care to eligible patients, and participating in the planning and implementation of preventative-curative medical care programs. The role requires 2-5 years of experience. Role Context and Scope The ENT Specialist functions both individually and as a member of the ENT division, delivering a full range of diagnostic care for disorders of the ears, nose, throat, and head and neck regions. This includes medical treatment and surgical intervention for various pathologies such as congenital, developmental, infectious, inflammatory, neoplastic, and traumatic presentations. The specialist operates under the administrative and clinical supervision of the Senior Otolaryngologist and the Division Chief, with standards of care aligned with JHAH and JCAHO requirements. Frequent contact with patients, physicians, and other specialists is an integral part of the work. Key Responsibilities Perform professional duties as an Otorhinolaryngologist. Provide consultation to other physicians for problems within the field of ear, nose, throat, head, and neck surgery, including diagnosis and treatment. Complete medical records promptly, indicating diagnosis, treatment, and future courses of action, ensuring conformity to established requirements. Participate in group conferences requiring specialist viewpoints on complex medical cases. Collaborate with departmental personnel in planning and operating approved curative-preventive programs relevant to the specialty. Address daily inquiries regarding irregular work and problems within the group, including technical, safety, and accident issues. Monitor the work of assigned staff within the Otorhinolaryngology Service for quality, quantity, and correctness, providing demonstrations or recommending additional training as needed. Attend staff meetings and participate in in-service activities as requested. Inform the supervisor of unusual situations or problems encountered and actions taken. Ensure assigned personnel observe all medical regulations to the delegated degree. Advise assigned personnel on matters necessary for harmonious relationships and on infringements of medical or Company rules. Advise the supervisor on assigned personnel's performance and other administrative matters. Perform other miscellaneous related duties as requested. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2-5 years of relevant experience is required. Ability to provide routine and emergency diagnostic and therapeutic care in Otorhinolaryngology. Proficiency in medical treatment and surgical intervention for a range of ear, nose, throat, head, and neck disorders. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Qatif, Saudi Arabia, within Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare. The role involves working closely with a team of physicians and specialists, contributing to a collaborative healthcare environment focused on patient care and program implementation. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

a59574089b45fbc9.description: About the Role NMDC Energy is seeking a Senior Offshore Construction Engineer for full-time projects located in Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This role is responsible for coordinating and monitoring activities across various project execution phases, assisting, and leading Construction Engineers in assigned tasks. The Senior Offshore Construction Engineer will report to the Offshore Construction Manager / Sr. Offshore Construction Manager and may work on multiple projects simultaneously. Key Responsibilities Across Project Phases Assist the Offshore Construction Manager (OCM) in preparing offshore project deliverables, attending project kick-off and strategy meetings, and supporting the development of offshore execution plans, construction schedules, and techno-commercial analyses. Prepare construction aids (load register), define marine spread requirements, manage pipe coating scope, and monitor fabrication/pipe coating progress. Review engineering documents, drawings, and analyses from a constructability perspective. Support the preparation of detailed scopes, schedules, and interface/bridging documents for offshore subcontracted works (excluding diving and NDT), and coordinate technical and commercial evaluations. Act as a focal point for subcontractor coordination, monitoring progress and performance. Support the issuance of Purchase Requisitions for offshore materials not covered by engineering and follow up with procurement on ordering and delivery. Coordinate offshore scope activities with all internal departments. Attend methods and constructability meetings and review installation procedures, anchor patterns, and drawings. Assist in technical evaluation, expediting, receipt, and MRV approval of offshore materials. Provide input to weekly and monthly reports and attend client meetings as required. Support studies for changes in offshore execution plans, including the preparation of bridging documents, micro-schedules, and method statements. Liaise with third-party agencies and marine warranty surveyors on marine and construction matters. Attend weekly progress meetings with VPOO/OCM and highlight issues and risks. Ensure the implementation of the project safety plan, company HSEMS, and quality standards. Capture lessons learned and best practices, and participate in quality audits and closeout actions. Initiate offshore variation orders/claims, compile technical inputs, and support the assignment of offshore durations. Assist in reviewing subcontractor invoices and provide clarifications to finance. Prepare and coordinate mobilization plans and support mobilization meetings with marine and field teams. Pre-Offshore and Execution Phase Responsibilities Prepare the Risk Assessment Register, attend RA meetings, and circulate consolidated comments to the client and internal stakeholders. Prepare job cards for offshore hook-up works and develop detailed micro-schedules and manpower histograms for shutdown activities. Prepare JUB specifications for hired marine spread in line with CHOD requirements. Coordinate with OPE to ensure the readiness and mobilization of all installation aids. Ensure timely pre-installation/load-out activities and the availability of the latest approved offshore documentation onboard. Assist in updating offshore schedules based on progress and resource availability, and propose recovery measures for delays. Support coordination of subcontractor mobilization/demobilization and performance evaluation. Monitor daily offshore operations, attend daily meetings, and coordinate closely with clients, marine, and field teams. Conduct HSE audits and safety tours on offshore spreads. Interface with project and yard construction teams to maintain load-out dates and offshore continuity. Conduct joint walk-throughs on fabricated structures to avoid offshore carry-over. Close-Out Phase Responsibilities Assist in the preparation of offshore final documentation and project close-out reports. Review contract documents and drawings to identify constructability issues and variation requirements. Support Construction Managers in directing offshore activities, ensuring resource availability, safety compliance, and adherence to contract and ISO requirements. Assist in schedule adjustments to manage changes, delays, and contingencies while controlling costs. Qualifications and Requirements 5-10 years of relevant experience. Candidates currently based in KSA or willing to relocate to KSA will be considered. Candidates with experience working on Aramco projects will be given priority. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Eastern, Saudi Arabia, focusing on projects within the Kingdom. The role requires close coordination with various internal departments, clients, and third-party agencies, ensuring adherence to project safety plans, company HSEMS, and quality standards.

a5bf8b5c43559c6f.description: Permanent IP Services Administrator Job Purpose To handle administrative functions relating to the management and prosecution of trade marks, patents and designs. Job Requirements The main responsibilities of the role are to: Utilise tools within an intellectual property database to prepare trade mark, patent and design application forms and other routine English language documentation relating to the filing and prosecution of trade mark, patent and design applications. Organise the translation of correspondence between Clyde & Co and the Trade Marks and Patent Office (i.e. arranging for letters from the Office to be translated into English and for letters from Clyde & Co to the Trade Marks or Patent Office to be translated into English and Arabic). Liaise with case handlers to prepare routine letters and documents (based on precedents). This will include, for example, trade mark approval sheets, Powers of Attorney and standard letters instructing corresponding agents and reporting to clients. Management of original documents. Make telephone calls to the Trade Marks and Patent Offices. Accurately enter data into the trade mark database. Take responsibility for the quality of all work produced. Effectively monitor all case deadlines. Provide cover for team member absences. Ad hoc duties as directed by IP Operations Manager. Candidate Requirements We are interested in candidates with: Education up to high school level or equivalent; degree desirable. Previous administration experience gained within professional services; trade mark or patent administration experience essential. Excellent written and spoken Arabic and English. Exceptional attention to detail. Excellent organisational skills. An ability to work in a team — the role will involve working as part of a team of administrators and receiving instructions from paralegals and case handlers. An ability to multi-task. An ability to prioritise a very busy workload and work effectively under pressure. An ability to work to tight case deadlines and take a proactive approach to work. The Firm When you work at Clyde & Co, you join a team of 500 partners, 2,400 lawyers, 3,200 legal professionals and 5,500 people in nearly 70 offices and associated offices worldwide. Our values are the principles that guide the decisions we make, unite us in our endeavours and strengthen our delivery, for both our clients and our firm. We work as one, excel with clients, celebrate difference and act boldly. We are committed to operating in a responsible way by progressing towards a diverse and inclusive workforce that reflects the communities and clients it serves. We are devoted to providing an environment in which everyone can realise their potential, using its legal and professional skills to support its communities. We do this through pro bono work, volunteering and charitable partnerships, and minimising the impact it has on the environment, including through our commitment to the SBTi Net-Zero standard and the setting of ambitious emissions reduction targets. Our Commitment Clyde & Co is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. Our values encourage us to support fairness, celebrate diversity and prohibit all forms of discrimination in the workplace to allow everyone to excel at work. Therefore, we welcome and encourage all applications from suitably qualified individuals, regardless of background or identity. Learn more about our interview process. A Note on Privacy Please take a moment to read our privacy notice. This describes what personal information Clyde & Co (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject. If you are submitting a candidate as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is an essential requirement and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to Clyde & Co are aware of this privacy notice. This is the job description as constituted at present; however, Clyde & Co reserves the right to reasonably amend it in accordance with the changing needs of the business. الشركة عند انضمامك إلى شركة كلايد أند كو، تصبح جزءًا من فريق عالمي يضم 500 شريك، و2400 محامٍ، و3200 متخصص قانوني، وأكثر من 5500 موظف فيما يقارب 70 مكتباً وفرعاً حول العالم . تشكل قيمنا المبادئ التي توجه قراراتنا، وتوحدنا في مساعينا، وتعزز جودة أدائنا سواء تجاه عملائنا أو شركتنا. نعمل بروح الفريق الواحد، ونتميّز في خدمة عملائنا، ونحتفي بالاختلاف، ونتصرف بجرأة. نلتزم بالعمل بمسؤولية من خلال السعي نحو بناء قوة عاملة متنوعة وشاملة تعكس المجتمعات والعملاء الذين نخدمهم. كما نكرس جهودنا لتوفير بيئة تمكّن الجميع من تحقيق إمكاناتهم الكاملة، وتسخير مهاراتهم القانونية والمهنية في دعم مجتمعاتهم. نُجسّد هذا الالتزام من خلال تقديم الخدمات القانونية المجانية، والمشاركة في الأعمال التطوعية، وبناء شراكات خيرية، إلى جانب تقليل أثرنا البيئي، بما في ذلك التزامنا بمعيار صافي الانبعاثات الصفرية ووضع أهداف طموحة لخفض الانبعاثات. التزامنا تفخر كلايد أند كو بكونها شركة ملتزمة بمبادئ تكافؤ الفرص. تشجعنا قيمنا على دعم العدالة، والاحتفاء بالتنوع، ورفض جميع أشكال التمييز في بيئة العمل، بما يتيح لكل فرد فرصة التميز والنجاح في مسيرته المهنية. ولذلك، نرحب بجميع طلبات التوظيف من الأفراد المؤهلين، بغض النظر عن خلفياتهم أو هوياتهم. للتعرّف على خطوات عملية المقابلة لدينا . ملاحظة بشأن الخصوصية نرجو منك تخصيص بعض الوقت لقراءة إشعار الخصوصية الخاص بنا، والذي يوضح البيانات الشخصية التي قد تحتفظ بها الشركة، وأغراض استخدامها، وآلية جمعها، وحقوقك بصفتك صاحب بيانات وطرق التواصل معنا. إذا كنت تقدم مرشحاً بالنيابة عن وكالة توظيف شريكة، فإن من مسؤوليتك الأساسية والضرورية التأكد من أن المرشح المتقدم للعمل لدى الشركة قد اطّلع على هذا الإشعار . يرجى ملاحظة أن هذا الوصف الوظيفي يعكس الوضع الحالي، إلا أن شركة كلايد آند كو تحتفظ بحقها في تعديله بشكل معقول بما يتماشى مع احتياجات العمل المتغيرة .

a5d456a2be2b300c.description: About the company: At Almosafer Travel & Tourism Co, we’re not just part of the travel industry, we’re helping shape its future. As Saudi Arabia’s leading travel company, we serve millions across every segment of the travel and tourism ecosystem. Rooted in our name “Almosafer,” meaning the traveler, we strive to make every journey seamless, personal, and purposeful. Our diverse platforms and services are built to deliver enriching experiences that reflect the spirit of Saudi Arabia and the wider region. We’re united by a bold vision: To be the undisputed leader in travel services, fostering lasting connections and setting new benchmarks for excellence in the Kingdom and beyond. Our team across Saudi Arabia and the wider region blends deep cultural understanding with forward-thinking innovation, shaping a new standard for travel in the region. About the Role We are seeking a Product Designer to join our team focusing on the Digital Consumer Travel experience. In this role, you will play a key part in shaping the future of how customers book and manage a diverse range of travel products, including flights, stays, activities, and more. You will work in a cross-functional team of engineers, product managers, and other designers to turn problems and opportunities into meaningful and impactful experiences. This role requires a deep understanding of customer needs and behaviors, business objectives and market trends, and systems knowledge. Responsibilities: You will identify and understand customer needs, behaviors, and pain points and use this to define opportunities and problem statements that inform the team’s work. You will lead and support discovery activities such as user interviews, surveys, and usability tests to uncover customer needs and validate opportunities. You will work in a fast-paced team of engineers, product managers, and designers to uncover customer problems and deliver impactful solutions across multiple web and mobile platforms. You will consider the business needs, technical constraints, data, and platform requirements in order to produce impactful and valuable solutions. You will creatively translate opportunities into elegant, intuitive, and effective experiences that deliver customer and business value You will rapidly and pragmatically produce concepts and prototypes, understanding when further ideation, testing, or changing directions is needed. You will run experiments frequently to validate your assumptions and optimize your solutions. Profile requirements: You have 3-5 years of product design experience within a consumer focused organization and a proven record of successfully shipped mobile and web experiences. You demonstrate a deep understanding of product strategy and business requirements, with a strong focus on addressing customers’ needs and pain points. You are a design thinker and problem solver at heart, and you consistently strive to gain a deep understanding of the customers, business, and problems you are trying to solve. You are comfortable planning and conducting research from interviews and usability tests to surveys, and you integrate insights into your design process. You have the necessary communication skills to tell a story about your work and communicate complex concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders. You possess excellent visual design skills and are proficient in design, prototyping, and whiteboarding tools (such as Figma, Framer, Miro). You have experience working with and contributing to a design system. You regularly seek and give constructive feedback. You share and discuss your work openly at every stage without any “big reveals.” You love working with other designers and cross-functional team members and thrive on transparency and effective communication. You have an online portfolio or PDF you can share with us. Please include up to 3 projects that best represent your design thinking process and demonstrate the impact of your work. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered. You are experienced in the entire product design cycle: From UX research, wireframes and prototypes to the final design, implementation and optimization Proficient in design and prototyping tools (such as Figma, Framer, Proto.io) A strong visual design background with knowledge of Google Material Guidelines, Apple Human Interface Guidelines and design systems Solid understanding and experience in the field of research: interviewing users, setting up surveys and usability tests as well as interpreting the results Basic knowledge and experience leveraging data and analytics to inform design decisions Strong written and verbal communication skills in Arabic and English. Being you @ Almosafer: At Almosafer, our teams work with purpose, clarity, and a shared commitment to doing things the right way. Whether you're building platforms, supporting travelers, or shaping strategy, your work connects to something bigger. Across functions and locations, we value accountability, trust, and collaboration - and we create the structure and space for you to contribute meaningfully from day one. Here, you will find: A purpose-led workplace where your ideas can create real impact Ongoing learning and development to help you grow with intention Recognition that celebrates your wins, both big and small A community built on trust, curiosity, and shared momentum No matter where your journey started, at Almosafer, you will find space to grow, connect, and contribute meaningfully.

a5313c4409418ba6.description: About the Role Front End Limited Company is seeking an Offshore Director for a full-time position in Al Khobar. This role serves as the single point of accountability for the company's entire offshore business and operations, reporting directly to the CEO. The Offshore Director unifies marine operational command, fleet management, offshore project delivery, regulatory compliance, and commercial leadership to ensure safe and efficient fleet operations, and precise execution of offshore work with protected margins. Key Responsibilities Hold overall accountability for the safe, compliant, and commercially optimal operation of the owned and chartered fleet. Maximize fleet utilization and uptime while minimizing off-hire through disciplined planning and maintenance. Direct the movement of offshore units, overseeing anchoring, towing, mooring, and maneuvering within 500-meter zones. Oversee Dynamic Positioning (DP) operations, lifting operations, AHTS, rig-supply, and safety standby vessel operations. Govern diving and ROV operations and subsea intervention to required marine and safety standards. Own the offshore P&L, setting and delivering annual business plan, revenue, and margin targets. Build and convert the offshore commercial pipeline, leading identification, qualification, bids, tenders, RFQs, and proposals. Define commercial strategy and pricing logic, structuring charter and project contracts to protect margin and manage risk. Champion an uncompromising HSE culture and ensure full compliance with Saudi Aramco Marine / Offshore Operations Manual and international standards. Accountable for the delivery of contracted offshore projects, including mobilization, execution, milestones, schedule, cost, and close-out. Lead, structure, and develop the offshore organization across fleet/technical, marine operations, HSE, delivery, crewing, and commercial. Drive Saudization of the marine workforce in line with Saudi Aramco contractor requirements and national objectives. Scope of Offshore Business The Offshore Director is accountable for the full Front End Offshore capability portfolio across the marine asset lifecycle, spanning oil & gas, renewables, and maritime infrastructure. This includes: Construction & Installation: Marine vessel chartering, subsea installation, offshore platform transportation and heavy-lift installation, subsea pipeline installation, and well completion systems. Surveying & Monitoring: Pre-lay and post-lay subsea surveys, as-laid and as-built verification, platform and subsea structure inspections, marine seismic acquisition, and structural monitoring. Drilling & Decommissioning: Jack-up rig operations, offshore drilling, and offshore platform removal and decommissioning. Logistics & Support: Emergency and routine fueling, autonomous aerial logistics, ROV operations, and integrated offshore support services. Offshore Mining: Polymetallic nodule collection and subsea mining technologies. Qualifications and Experience Senior leadership experience (typically 15+ years) in offshore marine / OSV operations, with a substantial track record managing fleets and offshore projects in the oil & gas sector. Demonstrable P&L ownership and commercial / business-development success in winning and profitably delivering offshore charter and/or subsea/project contracts. Deep, current working knowledge of Saudi Aramco offshore/marine operating requirements and the regional offshore market. Strong command of marine HSE, marine assurance, and international standards (IMO, DNV, BIMCO, OCIMF, ISPS). A marine/nautical or engineering background (*, Master Mariner / Chief Engineer Certificate of Competency, or an engineering degree) combined with business education (MBA or equivalent commercial credential strongly preferred). Experience operating at executive level and reporting to a CEO or Board. Established Saudi Aramco and tier-1 client relationships and qualification experience are desirable. Experience with subsea, survey, drilling support, decommissioning, and/or offshore renewables scopes is desirable. Knowledge of Saudization frameworks and the Saudi maritime regulatory environment is an advantage; Arabic language skills are also an advantage. Core Competencies Marine & technical authority Operational discipline Business acumen & commercial savviness Leadership & coordination Client & stakeholder management Judgment under pressure Performance Indicators Fleet utilization and off-hire performance against the standardized model. HSE performance (incident and near-miss rates; Aramco/marine audit outcomes). Offshore revenue, margin, and EBITDA versus plan. Bid win-rate and pipeline conversion; quality and discipline of contract terms. On-time, on-budget project delivery and clean, on-schedule vessel redeliveries. Saudi Aramco qualification standing and client satisfaction. Saudization and crew-competency targets.

a56c2611de33af3c.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a PMIS Specialist to join its team in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves contributing expertise to the implementation of project management information systems (PMIS) on large client programs within the EMEA region. The specialist will work as part of the implementation delivery team, operating with a degree of independence on assigned projects due to sufficient training, technical expertise, and exposure to the project and program environment. The role involves working within a team focused on delivering PMIS solutions for large client programs. Company Overview Parsons Corporation is committed to fostering an innovative culture that values its people, embraces agility, and promotes growth. The company empowers its employees to achieve their full potential and contribute to significant programs. a585a3ce5fe2aefc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركة العربية للتموين والمقاولات المعمارية عن مراقب جودة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان جودة المنتجات والأعمال المدنية من خلال الفحص والتحليل والمراقبة المستمرة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمهنيين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع عينات المنتجات من مراحل التصنيع المختلفة، بما في ذلك المنتجات قيد التصنيع والمنتجات النهائية. إجراء الفحوصات اللازمة على عينات المنتجات للتحقق من مطابقتها لمعايير الجودة المطلوبة وتوثيق النتائج بدقة. تحديد مصادر العيوب المحتملة وتقديم التوصيات الفعالة للتخفيف من آثارها. تحديث سياسات وإجراءات الجودة بشكل دوري لضمان فعاليتها ومواكبتها لأفضل الممارسات. مراقبة جودة الأعمال المدنية وعمال المشروع لضمان الالتزام بالمعايير المحددة. إعداد التقارير الدورية حول نتائج مراقبة الجودة والتحاليل المنجزة. الحفاظ على الخبرات الفنية وتحديث المعرفة بالاتجاهات الصناعية واللوائح الحكومية ذات الصلة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال مراقبة الجودة أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على جمع العينات وفحصها وتحليلها بدقة. فهم جيد لسياسات وإجراءات الجودة. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير وتوثيق النتائج. بيئة العمل والمزايا توفر الشركة العربية للتموين والمقاولات المعمارية بيئة عمل متعاونة ومرنة تشجع على النمو المهني. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، يحصل الموظفون على تأمين صحي شامل. الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم للوظيفة إذا كنت تستوفي المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه وتبحث عن فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل محترف في الجبيل، ندعوك للتقديم.

a59813fddaa356a6.description: Position Overview We are seeking a friendly, reliable, and customer-focused Customer Service Representative to join our remote customer support team. This entry-level position involves assisting customers with inquiries, providing accurate information, resolving routine concerns, processing service requests, updating customer records, and ensuring a positive customer experience through professional communication. The ideal candidate is patient, organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable communicating through email, chat, phone, and online customer service platforms. Previous professional customer service experience is not required. Comprehensive onboarding, training, and ongoing support will be provided. Recent graduates, career changers, individuals returning to the workforce, and candidates seeking their first remote professional opportunity are encouraged to apply. Key Responsibilities Customer Communication & Support Respond to customer inquiries through email, live chat, phone, or approved communication channels. Provide accurate information regarding products, services, accounts, orders, and company procedures. Assist customers with routine questions, requests, and concerns. Communicate clearly, patiently, and professionally. Guide customers through standard processes and troubleshooting steps. Maintain a friendly, respectful, and customer-focused approach. Follow up on unresolved inquiries when necessary. Customer Issue Resolution Identify customer concerns and determine appropriate solutions. Resolve routine issues using approved company procedures. Provide clear explanations regarding next steps and expected processes. Maintain accurate records of customer concerns and resolutions. Support customer satisfaction through timely and effective assistance. Customer Account & Records Management Enter and update customer information in company systems. Identify missing, duplicate, or outdated information. Correct routine record errors when authorized. Protect confidential customer information and follow privacy procedures. Ticket & Request Management Create, categorize, and update customer support tickets. Maintain accurate notes regarding customer inquiries and actions taken. Track open, pending, and resolved requests. Monitor follow-up requirements and service deadlines. Update ticket statuses as work progresses. Escalate requests requiring additional assistance. Close completed cases according to established procedures. Order & Service Support Assist customers with routine order, delivery, billing, or service-related inquiries. Provide updates using approved company information. Process authorized requests and account changes. Help customers understand applicable company policies and procedures. Review customer information before submitting updates. Identify recurring customer concerns and report them appropriately. Maintain accurate documentation of customer interactions. Remote Team Collaboration Communicate professionally with colleagues through email, chat, and virtual meetings. Coordinate customer requests with relevant departments. Provide updates on pending or unresolved cases. Request clarification when instructions are incomplete. Participate in virtual meetings, onboarding, and training sessions. Maintain dependable communication during scheduled working hours. Work independently while contributing to team goals. Required Qualifications High school diploma, GED, or equivalent. Basic computer and typing proficiency. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Friendly, patient, and professional attitude. Good listening and interpersonal skills. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Basic problem-solving abilities. Good organizational and time-management skills. Ability to follow established policies and procedures. Ability to manage multiple routine customer requests. Willingness to learn customer service tools and software. Ability to work independently in a remote environment. Dependable and professional work habits. Ability to maintain customer confidentiality. Reliable internet connection and suitable remote workspace. Preferred Qualifications Previous professional experience is not required. Familiarity with any of the following may be beneficial: Customer service or customer support. Email, chat, or phone-based communication. Retail, hospitality, or other customer-facing activities. CRM or customer support platforms. Ticket-management systems. Microsoft Office or Google Workspace. Customer account or order processing. Data entry and record maintenance. Remote communication and collaboration tools. Experience gained through internships, volunteer work, academic projects, freelance assignments, or other customer-facing activities may also be considered. Skills & Competencies Successful candidates should demonstrate: Customer-focused communication. Active listening and patience. Problem-solving and conflict resolution. Professional written and verbal communication. Strong attention to detail. Accurate data entry and documentation. Customer account management. Time management and multitasking. Adaptability and willingness to learn. Dependability and professionalism. Confidential information handling. Ability to work independently and collaboratively. Desired Candidate Profile High school diploma, GED, or equivalent. Basic computer and typing proficiency. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Friendly, patient, and professional attitude. Good listening and interpersonal skills. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Basic problem-solving abilities. Good organizational and time-management skills. Ability to follow established policies and procedures. Ability to manage multiple routine customer requests. Willingness to learn customer service tools and software. Ability to work independently in a remote environment. Dependable and professional work habits. Ability to maintain customer confidentiality. Reliable internet connection and suitable remote workspace.

a5cd77b365090b24.description: About the Internship Medtronic is seeking a Training and Education Intern for its Diabetes business. a5e00957665c9600.description: About Bouygues Travaux Publics KSA Bouygues Travaux Publics KSA specializes in civil engineering, underground tunneling, and complex structures, delivering major infrastructure and land-use projects globally. As part of Bouygues Travaux Publics, the company is committed to sustainable construction, diversity, and welcoming talent from all backgrounds. The Role of Project Data Senior Engineer The Project Data Senior Engineer at Bouygues Travaux Publics KSA in Al Ula is responsible for reviewing and validating design data, ensuring model integrity, and supporting procurement and construction processes. This contract position requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Duties and Responsibilities Review incoming excavation and building design packages for data completeness, model integrity, geometry, quantities, and technical specifications suitable for procurement and construction. Extract and validate Material Take-Offs (MTO), including excavation volumes, ground support systems, rockbolts, steel sets, structural, architectural, and MEP quantities. Develop and maintain an integrated 3D design model, incorporating design updates and monitoring design maturity at key project stages. Track quantity changes from design revisions and provide clear variance analyses to Technical, Estimating, Finance, Procurement, and Operations teams. Identify design inconsistencies, clashes, missing information, and multidisciplinary coordination issues; escalate critical items to the Technical Director. Maintain traceability of design assumptions, model versions, RFIs, and design changes, ensuring all information is documented and controlled. Support the preparation of cost baselines, work-package scopes, and procurement requirements through accurate and validated design data. Contribute to the definition of design interfaces, handover points, trade sequencing, and construction phasing requirements. Develop 4D model outputs, visualizations, and construction sequence simulations to support planning, site access, and delivery coordination. Coordinate the integration of survey and as-built information into the project model. Compare as-built conditions and quantities against design and contractual requirements, highlighting discrepancies and supporting remedial-work or change assessments. Work closely with Design, Technical, Construction, Procurement, Planning, and Commercial teams to translate design information into construction-ready deliverables. Required Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated experience in Material Take-Offs, quantity tracking, design change management, and model version control. Good understanding of construction sequencing, work packaging, procurement interfaces, and as-built data management. Key Skills Strong ability to review multidisciplinary design models and identify coordination issues, data gaps, and constructability risks. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. Ability to communicate complex technical information clearly and work effectively with multidisciplinary stakeholders. Work Environment This is a contract position based in Al Ula, Saudi Arabia, within a company committed to sustainable construction and diversity.

a504ac040c34f5fc.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز سمير عباس الطبي عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقه في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء وترويج المنتجات والخدمات الطبية، مع التركيز على تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتحصيل الديون. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات التي يقدمها المركز. إعداد وتحديث قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، بما في ذلك بيانات الاتصال. التواصل مع العملاء وزيارتهم لتقديم عروض البيع الترويجية للمنتجات والخدمات. استعراض مواصفات المنتجات وميزاتها التنافسية للعملاء المحتملين. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة. إتمام عمليات البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة العملاء لتحصيل الديون وتسجيلها وتوثيقها وتوريدها للدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على بناء وإدارة قواعد بيانات العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على إتمام عمليات البيع وتحصيل الديون. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل الموظف ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المركز وتوسيع قاعدة عملائه. نوع الوظيفة دوام كامل. الموقع الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية.

a57a0d333a2892d8.description: Job description Overview Working across the globe, V2X builds smart solutions designed to integrate physical and digital infrastructure from base to battlefield. We bring 120 years of successful mission support to improve security, streamline logistics, and enhance readiness. Aligned around a shared purpose, our $3.9B company and 16,000 people work alongside our clients, here and abroad, to tackle their most complex challenges with integrity, respect, responsibility, and professionalism. The Power Production Assistant Site Manager is responsible for managing personnel, resources, and activities devoted to the Power Production operation of a 6M (initial load) Power Plant in accordance with the performance work statement. The qualified candidate will report to the Site Manager and may supervisor other American Nationals (ANs), Other Country Nationals (OCNs), and/or Local Nationals (LNs). Responsibilities + Shall function as Shift Lead and be responsible for managing personnel, resources, and activities devoted to the Power Production operation. + Shall act as Site Manager upon his/her absence. + Shall have knowledge of: Principles of electronics and electricity, including generation, conversion, transformation, distribution, and utilization; types, capacity, and purpose of low/medium voltage circuits, circuit breakers, switches, fuses, regulators, relays, instruments, and meters associated with electric generation and distribution; interpreting instrument and meter readings; wiring diagrams, schematics, drawings and technical publications; techniques of operating and maintaining internal combustion engines, generators, generating plants, distribution panels, and accessory equipment; use and purpose of test equipment; safety rules and practices; environmental policies; principles of management; and operation and repair of electrical power production systems. + Shall meet with government customer as needed. + Shall accomplish inspection and status reports with diagnosis, estimated timeline for repair actions and list of required parts upon discovery of deficiency. + Shall maintain and adhere to applicable technical orders and good commercial practices for all maintenance actions to include: coordination of work, requesting parts, receiving parts, installing, troubleshooting, testing, and repairing equipment or systems. + Shall provide written reports of hourly peak demand and fuel consumption, inspections, maintenance, repairs, tests, and certifications of each system or component as required. + Must be able to multi task and work in a high paced environment. Work with a sense of urgency to complete tasks safely, effectively and efficiently. + Responsible for meeting contractor’s work requirements, including scheduling of personnel, work supervision, and quality control. + Responsible for following a comprehensive quality and safety program in compliance with Vectrus, OSHA and United States Air Force (USAF) requirements. + Responsible for following a comprehensive, flexible, and properly documented training program. + Responsible for maintaining a safe, clean, sanitary, healthy, presentable, professional atmosphere, free of dust, clutter and trash in all working facilities and areas. + Responsible for proper utilization and safeguarding of all government and contractor provided property (e.g., to include government facilities, equipment and tools). + Responsible for precise execution of company time reporting procedures and accurate completion of timesheet. + Performs other duties as assigned. Qualifications Education/Certifications: + Associates degree required; Bachelor’s degree preferred. + As a condition of employment in Saudi Arabia, all candidates must successfully complete the Saudi Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development’s Qualification Verification Program (QVP) to ensure eligibility for visa processing and employment authorization. + Must have and maintain a valid U. S. SECRET Security Clearance prior to deployment. + Must have a current, valid U. S. Passport. + Must have a valid U.S. Driver’s License and able to drive with a manual transmission. + Must be able to communicate in English. + Must be able to pass employment and deployment qualification requirements that include psychological, medical, dental, drug testing, background checks, etc. + Candidates must successfully complete both online and hands on CBRN (chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear) defense training. Training includes the successful fit testing of DoD provided protective gear. Experience: + A minimum of five years' of experience in Power Production operations/electrical power generation field. + Must have an excellent understanding of all safety directives and polices regarding the operation of electronic equipment. Skills: + Must be proficient with Microsoft programs such as Outlook, Excel, Word, Power Point + Fluent in English with good verbal, reading and writing skills. + Ability to troubleshoot and solve technical problems. + Exercise discretion and good sound judgment. + Able and willing to work periods of long hours to meet mission requirements + Military experience in a contingency environment and knowledge and experience working with government contracts preferred. Work will be mainly outdoors with office space provided. Exposure to heat, cold, dust, noise, chemicals may occur. Overtime and shift work may be required depending on contractual needs. Employee must comply with all Federal, State and Local regulations and published Company work rules as well as written instructions. Task specific work environment training will be provided as required. Must be prepared to function in a wartime environment to support U. S. interests. 100% Overseas Assignment. We ensure all individuals are treated with fairness, respect, and dignity, recognizing the strength that comes from a workforce rich in diverse experiences, perspectives, and skills. This commitment, aligned with our core Vision and Values of Integrity, Respect, and Responsibility, allows us to leverage differences, encourage innovation, and expand our success in the global marketplace, ultimately enabling us to best serve our clients. Preferred candidate Years of experience 2+ years Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

a59051f9f2595ae1.company_name: شركة فهد صالح الرشودي وشركاؤه للاستشارات الهندسية
a59051f9f2595ae1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة هوم كود عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف والمتابعة للأعمال والأنظمة الميكانيكية ضمن مشاريع الإنشاءات والمقاولات والتشطيبات، مع ضمان جودة التنفيذ ومطابقته للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويركز على الإشراف المباشر على سير العمل في الموقع. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف المباشر على أنظمة التكييف والتهوية (HVAC). متابعة أعمال السباكة وشبكات المياه والصرف الصحي. الإشراف على أنظمة مكافحة الحريق. مراجعة المخططات الهندسية والتنسيق مع الأعمال المعمارية والكهربائية لضمان التكامل. متابعة أداء المقاولين والموردين، بالإضافة إلى أعمال التوريد والتنفيذ. متابعة إجراءات الاختبارات والتشغيل والاستلام، ومعالجة الملاحظات الفنية التي قد تظهر. إعداد التقارير الدورية ومتابعة تقدم الأعمال في الموقع. المؤهلات والمتطلبات درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة الميكانيكية. خبرة عملية في مشاريع الإنشاءات والمقاولات والتشطيبات. خبرة متخصصة في أنظمة التكييف والتهوية (HVAC)، أعمال السباكة، وأنظمة مكافحة الحريق. عضوية سارية في الهيئة السعودية للمهندسين. إجادة قراءة المخططات الهندسية واستخدام برنامج AutoCAD، ويفضل من لديه خبرة في برنامج Revit. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات جيدة في إدارة المواقع الإنشائية. قدرة عالية على التنسيق والمتابعة الفعالة لسير العمل. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق شركة هوم كود في المدينة المنورة، في بيئة عمل تركز على تنفيذ مشاريع الإنشاءات والمقاولات والتشطيبات بكفاءة وجودة عالية. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عملنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للنظر فيها.

a52a14e5cb2f3bab.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة دانكو التجارية عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة العمليات المالية اليومية، بما في ذلك إعداد المستندات المحاسبية، متابعة الإيرادات، وتسجيل القيود المالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى تنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات، وتدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. نطاق العمل يشمل الدور إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها. كما يتضمن إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية، وتدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات الضرورية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وحفظ التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. معرفة قوية بالمبادئ المحاسبية وإجراءات التدقيق المالي. القدرة على إعداد التقارير المالية وتحليل البيانات. نوع الوظيفة والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق مالي لدعم العمليات التجارية لشركة دانكو التجارية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف.

a542c276b97928be.description: About the Role Bupa Arabia is seeking an Assistant Manager, External Corporate Governance to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role focuses on managing and coordinating the company's external corporate governance obligations, ensuring timely and accurate completion of market disclosures, shareholder matters, related-party transactions, and statutory filings in compliance with regulatory requirements. Role Purpose and Impact The Assistant Manager provides practical governance advice to the business, maintains comprehensive and audit-ready records, and contributes to transparency, regulatory confidence, and effective shareholder governance. The position is critical for upholding compliance and maintaining strong relationships with external stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Manage market disclosures and announcements, including assessing triggers, coordinating with stakeholders (Finance, Legal, Investor Relations), drafting and reviewing announcements, obtaining approvals, publishing through approved channels, and maintaining disclosure registers. Deliver shareholder and General Assembly governance by developing timetables, coordinating agendas, notices, supporting papers, voting arrangements, communications, and regulatory requirements, as well as documenting resolutions and following up on implementation. Coordinate related-party transaction (RPT) governance, which involves obtaining and assessing RPT information, coordinating documentation with Finance and Legal, managing review, approval, disclosure, and follow-up processes, maintaining the RPT register, and highlighting gaps. Maintain external governance compliance and statutory filings by managing a regulatory calendar, monitoring requirements and developments, coordinating periodic filings, identifying compliance gaps, and supporting the implementation of regulatory changes. Strengthen reporting, records, and process effectiveness through preparing governance updates and reports, maintaining a repository of external governance records, improving templates and procedures, and supporting assurance or audit requests. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 years of relevant experience. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with responsibilities covering operations in Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves working within a structured corporate environment focused on regulatory compliance and governance. Application Information Salary details for this position will be disclosed during the application process.
