a5b651ab88b95910.description: About dmg events dmg events is an international exhibitions and publishing company that attracts over 650,000 visitors to its global portfolio of 115+ exhibitions annually. The company's objective is to accelerate business through face-to-face events, creating opportunities for networking, learning, and business development. dmg events is part of the Daily Mail Group Trust (DMGT), a multinational portfolio of companies with total revenues of £2bn, providing information, analysis, insight, events, news, and entertainment to businesses and consumers. The Role of Conference Producer (Saudi National) dmg events is seeking a Conference Producer (Saudi National) in Riyadh. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on the timely production of high-quality, industry-relevant summit and industry talks programs tailored to the construction market. The Conference Producer will be responsible for developing and expanding these programs for various events within the construction portfolio by generating new ideas and topics and securing industry-leading speakers. Key Responsibilities Produce industry-relevant summit/conference and workshop programs. Manage the CPD accreditation for delivered programs. Oversee onsite management of summit/conference and workshop programs at events, ensuring delivery according to plan. Brief and supervise temporary staff involved in onsite delivery. Determine the viability of proposed programs through research. Identify and liaise with key industry leaders, institutions, and companies in relevant topic areas. Conduct effective research with relevant industry professionals and the target market. Develop research findings into attractive draft programs. Contact and confirm identified speakers, maintaining regular communication to prevent last-minute dropouts. Maintain and build relationships to curate best-in-class summits/conferences and workshops. Collaborate with marketing to promote programs and speakers. Work with related Directors and team members to generate new ideas for content programs. Work closely with the sponsorship team by providing relevant leads and participating in sponsorship calls when necessary. Build relationships through networking with delegates and speakers at events. Manage and build relationships with advisory boards and industry associations. Perform any other duties that reasonably correspond to the role’s responsibilities and level. Experience Required Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field, demonstrating the ability to produce high-quality, industry-specific programs and manage event logistics effectively.

a5c49487a2e18c14.description: JOB PURPOSE The Director, Commercial & Partnerships Development leads the development and structuring of commercial and partnership arrangements that support QHC’s business development priorities. Reporting to the Executive — Business Development, the role develops commercial and partnership requirements, leads partner engagement and sourcing, and develops partnership propositions, commercial models and contracting requirements for priority opportunities. This is a Day-1 role because priority commercial and partnership opportunities require early market engagement, structured evaluation and sufficient lead time to develop and secure. Establishing these capabilities early supports QHC’s commercial and partnership development agenda. The role works across the leadership team, the Qiddiya ecosystem and external stakeholders to build a partnership pipeline, structure commercial and contractual arrangements, govern partner obligations, and coordinate brand and launch activity that positions QHC in the market. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES 1. Partnership Strategy & Pipeline Development • Develop partner requirements and shape partnership and commercial priorities aligned with QHC's clinical, operational and growth priorities. • Build and manage a prioritized pipeline of partnership and commercial opportunities across sports, healthcare, payer, technology and ecosystem partners. • Identify and evaluate new commercial and partnership models and develop recommendations for leadership review. 2. Partner Engagement, Sourcing & Deal Origination • Lead partner identification, engagement and sourcing, representing QHC with credibility to external partners and stakeholders. • Originate and progress priority partnership opportunities, leading partner engagement, evaluation, negotiation preparation and follow-up through to agreement. 3. Commercial Structuring & Contracting • Develop and structure commercial arrangements, commercial models and contracting requirements, ensuring deals are commercially sound and operationally deliverable. • Coordinate contracting, obligations and commercial structuring in partnership with legal, finance and relevant functions. • Develop commercial terms and recommendations that protect QHC’s interests and align with relevant service and partnership requirements. 4. Partner Management • Track partner obligations and deliverables ensuring commitments on both sides are met. • Coordinate partner governance, performance monitoring, issue resolution and escalation for active partnerships. • Maintain the partner and contract register and report on partnership performance. 5. Ecosystem & Stakeholder Relationships • Develop and manage commercial and partnership relationships across the Qiddiya ecosystem and with relevant external partners. • Coordinate with QIC and ecosystem partners to leverage shared opportunities and avoid duplication. • Act as a key relationship point for priority commercial and partnership stakeholders. 6. Brand, Marketing & Launch Coordination • Coordinate brand, awareness and launch communications in partnership with marketing and communications, given QHC's reputational exposure. • Ensure partnership and commercial activity is aligned with and supportive of QHC's brand and market positioning. • Support go-to-market and launch milestones across the startup phase. 7. Commercial Performance & Revenue Growth • Contribute to QHC's revenue growth, service monetization and competitive positioning through partnerships and commercial arrangements. • Provide commercial input to business cases, pricing and new service-line development. • Track and report commercial and partnership KPIs to leadership. EXPERIENCE & ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, Law, or a related field is required. A Master's degree (MBA or equivalent) is preferred. 8+ Years of progressive experience in commercial, partnerships, business development or deal-making roles, including experience in developing commercial models, structuring partnership opportunities and supporting complex negotiations and contracting and managing senior external relationships. Demonstrated experience in partnership development and commercial structuring, ideally within healthcare, sports, entertainment, government / semi-government or large ecosystem-based environments. External credibility with senior stakeholders is essential. Strong commercial, negotiation and relationship-management capability, with working knowledge of the Saudi market and Vision 2030 context. Experience developing investment cases, commercial models and contracting requirements is highly desirable.

a57e399413d7f36d.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking a Receiving Clerk to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is essential for ensuring accurate billing and payment processes, contributing to the overall guest experience through efficient financial operations. The position is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Process invoices and commissions, including generating accurate invoices and ensuring timely payment or deduction of travel agent commissions. Maintain account accuracy by promptly posting charges and credits, and reconciling subsidiary ledgers with the general ledger. Monitor and collect payments, following up on outstanding balances to maintain positive cash flow and reduce overdue accounts. Resolve billing issues by investigating account discrepancies and coordinating with relevant teams to resolve disputes. Prepare and send statements, issuing timely account statements with a target for daily delivery. Review daily transactions, auditing previous day’s charges for accuracy, proper documentation, and contractual compliance. Manage credit metrics, calculating monthly Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) and assisting with credit management reporting to support timely collections and financial accuracy. Qualifications and Core Values Candidates for this role should align with Hilton's core values, which define success within the organization: A commitment to Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and consistently doing the right thing. Demonstrating Leadership by inspiring others. Believing that Teamwork drives optimal outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. A focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment. About Hilton Hilton is a global leader in hospitality, recognized for its workplace culture and commitment to providing exceptional experiences for both guests and team members. The company has received repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. Hilton operates a suite of world-class brands and is dedicated to setting new standards for the future of travel. Career Development Hilton supports career journeys, whether individuals are starting their careers or exploring new opportunities. The company aims to provide an environment where team members can grow professionally.

a5bd6a48d703c3c5.description: About the Role Bechtel Corporation is seeking a Resident Engineering Structural professional for a full-time position in Saudi Arabia. This role involves conducting field investigations and client interviews to define the scope and cost estimates for the civil/structural aspects of projects. The successful candidate will lead design, development, modification, evaluation, and constructability reviews, ensuring that unique and complex civil/structural requirements are met through technical expertise. Key Responsibilities Plan, schedule, conduct, or coordinate detailed phases of civil/structural engineering work for a global business unit, project, or staff group. This includes preparing original designs, layouts, details, drawings, and specifications for structures, buildings, roadways, and railroads. Design, develop, modify, and evaluate Civil/Structural components and processes using relevant Engineering Department Procedures (EDPs), design standards and guides, Bechtel Standard Application Programs (BSAPs), Design Control Check List (DCCL), and Design Review Notices (DRNs). Design structures utilizing advanced knowledge of structural analysis, including statics, dynamics, and materials engineering. Determine the appropriate use of various structural elements such as steel, wood, masonry, and concrete, ensuring material selection is based on load or stress requirements. Originate and check complex structural engineering deliverables, including steel and concrete calculations, specifications, and material requisitions. Analyze problems with conflicting design requirements, sketching ideas and possible solutions. Analyze and report on the suitability of unconventional materials, techniques, and/or difficult coordination requirements. Plan, coordinate, or prepare equipment, work, and material specifications, bid evaluations, and award recommendations. Prepare procurement and subcontract requisition documents and perform associated technical bid evaluations with award recommendations. Provide assistance to project and construction management in identifying and complying with project Civil/Structural requirements and in addressing issues during project execution. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in a relevant engineering field. The role requires a strong background in civil/structural engineering principles and practices, with a focus on design, analysis, and constructability.

a5b6a75af2e7dc19.description: About Flowserve Flowserve is a global manufacturer specializing in pumps, valves, seals, and aftermarket services. The company provides comprehensive flow control solutions for essential industries such as energy, clean water, and pharmaceuticals. Flowserve fosters a culture built on ingenuity, innovation, and excellence, offering opportunities for professional growth and competitive rewards, grounded in core values including People, Safety, Integrity, Ownership, and Ingenuity. Role Overview Flowserve is seeking an HSE Site Coordinator for a full-time position in Dammam. This role is crucial for driving a strong safety culture and ensuring operational compliance across facility operations. The coordinator will focus on maintaining workplace safety standards, leading continuous improvement initiatives, managing incident reporting, coordinating safety training, and ensuring full compliance with local Saudi Arabian HSE legislation and Flowserve corporate standards. The position requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Maintain a high level of housekeeping and implement 5S in the facility, conducting audits every three months. Conduct daily walk-through safety inspections, report findings to the immediate supervisor, and log them in Sphera. Review local standards and ensure compliance requirements are communicated to the immediate supervisor and top management. Organize monthly HSE committee meetings and weekly toolbox meetings, providing necessary reports. Report all Near Miss, First Aid, Loss Time, environmental, fire, and vehicular incidents to Sphera, encouraging all associates to report observations. Review all reports in Sphera and regularly update the HSE RAIL. Manage environmental, health, and safety activities through strong leadership, communication, and motivation of the safety committee. Conduct rigorous incident investigations focused on prevention, root cause analysis, and injury prevention leading indicators. Coordinate safety training for all employees on Safety, Health, and Environmental matters. Develop and administer New Hire Orientation Safety Training. Investigate and maintain records for all work-related injuries and illnesses, provide statistical analysis, and assist department management in developing effective health and safety countermeasures. Serve as co-chair on the Joint Health and Safety Committee, coordinating activities, recommendations, and accountability for issues identified by safety regulations and Flowserve corporate audits. Conduct monthly workplace safety audits, establish measurable standards, and follow up on recommendations for continuous improvement. Coordinate emergency evacuation procedures, training, and practice drills. Ensure all environmental reports pertaining to air, storm water, and sanitary sewer discharge permits are submitted accurately and on time. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2-5 years of experience in a related HSE role. Demonstrated ability to maintain workplace safety standards and ensure compliance with regulations. Experience with incident reporting, root cause analysis, and safety training coordination. Strong understanding of local Saudi Arabian HSE legislation and corporate safety standards. Proficiency in implementing and maintaining 5S methodologies. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Dammam, where the HSE Site Coordinator will play a vital role in fostering a safe and compliant operational environment within Flowserve's facilities. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to join Flowserve and contribute to creating extraordinary flow control solutions.

a506d99b940479a9.description: About the Role The Ritz-Carlton is seeking a Sous Chef to oversee daily kitchen operations. This full-time role involves leading kitchen staff, managing food-related functions, and ensuring high-quality product consistency. The Sous Chef is accountable for improving guest and employee satisfaction while adhering to the operating budget and maintaining sanitation and food standards. Company Culture and Standards At The Ritz-Carlton, a Marriott International brand, the "Gold Standards" guide daily operations, focusing on delivering luxury service. These standards, including the Employee Promise, Credo, and Service Values, are foundational to the brand's reputation. The company is committed to being an equal opportunity employer, valuing diverse backgrounds and fostering an environment of creativity, thoughtfulness, and compassion among its associates. Key Responsibilities Manage kitchen shift operations and ensure compliance with Food & Beverage policies, standards, and procedures. Estimate daily production needs weekly and communicate these to kitchen personnel daily. Assist the Executive Chef with all kitchen operations and food preparation. Prepare and cook various types of food for regular service, special guests, or functions. Develop, design, or create new applications, ideas, relationships, systems, or products, including artistic contributions. Assist in determining food presentation and create decorative food displays. Maintain purchasing, receiving, and food storage standards. Ensure compliance with food handling and sanitation standards. Perform duties of kitchen managers and employees as necessary. Recognize superior quality products, presentations, and flavor. Ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations. Follow proper handling and temperature guidelines for all food products. Operate and maintain all department equipment and report malfunctions. Check the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure standards are met. Qualifications and Requirements 2-5 years of experience in a similar role. Ability to supervise and coordinate activities of cooks and food preparation workers. Proven leadership skills, including the ability to lead shifts while personally preparing food items. Strong interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage team members. Demonstrated honesty, integrity, and sound financial/business decision-making. Ability to foster mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members. Capacity to serve as a role model for appropriate behaviors. Skill in maintaining employee productivity levels and ensuring understanding of expectations. A track record of establishing and maintaining open, collaborative relationships with employees. Experience in ensuring property policies are administered fairly and consistently. Ability to communicate performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions. A record of recognizing successful performance and producing desired results. Work Type This is a full-time position.

a5465ee3da6c0615.description: About Medtronic Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology, committed to alleviating pain, restoring health, and extending life. With 95,000 employees across more than 150 countries, the company focuses on developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of over 72 million patients annually. Medtronic champions healthcare access and equity, fostering a career environment grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. Role Overview The Associate Customer Service Specialist serves as the primary contact for all customer order management within the region for Medtronic Saudi Arabia’s Business Units and the Medtronic International Customer Care & Supply Chain group. This full-time position, based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, involves processing sales and purchase orders and preparing related documentation. The role requires close cooperation with the Customer Care & Supply Chain Manager, Business Unit Managers, and Finance Manager, and supports sales activities while contributing to structural improvement projects. Candidates should have 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Represent the company to both external and internal customers. Process and follow up on customer orders in compliance with current policies, procedures, and work instructions. Monitor and follow up on financial (payment) situations, ensuring customers fulfill contractual terms in collaboration with the Finance department and Business Unit Managers. Support sales contracts and related documentation. Develop and maintain close day-to-day relationships with distributors and service providers. Maintain accurate Customer and Material Master Files. Collaborate with Customers and Business Unit Managers to identify and implement structural process improvements. Manage web-based ordering or registrations. Confer with management regarding customer credits, process returned goods for credit, identify quality assurance complaints, and manage price differentials on mail orders. Manage inventories at customer facilities using EDI, forecasting, replenishment, and inventory systems, focusing on stock and allocation issues to maximize service levels. Manage customer complaints and the return process. Coordinate on warranty issues. Maintain return acceptance criteria. Follow up on Distribution Hold Notifications and the return of hold products to Medtronic suppliers. Support the organization of efficient third-party warehousing & distribution operations. Support the establishment of an effective quality management system. Qualifications and Requirements 2-5 years of relevant experience. Good knowledge of Incoterms, customs clearance, and certification procedures. Understanding of product flow through third-party logistic suppliers to transit warehouses and final customers. Excellent communication skills. Ability to understand and comply with specific customer requirements and needs. Compensation and Benefits Medtronic offers a competitive salary and a flexible benefits package. The company is committed to its employees, recognizing their contributions and allowing them to share in the success they help create. A wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans are designed to support employees at every career and life stage. This position is eligible for the Medtronic Incentive Plan (MIP).

a58ff7f136bf6859.description: We are seeking a reliable and skilled Electrical Rider to join our dynamic team and ensure timely delivery of electrical equipment. This role requires a strong understanding of electrical systems and safe handling practices to maintain the integrity of our products during transit. The ideal candidate will be responsible for efficient transportation and delivery, contributing to our commitment to exceptional customer service. Key Responsibilities: * Safely operate an electrical vehicle for delivery purposes. * Transport and deliver electrical components and equipment to designated locations. * Maintain accurate delivery logs and ensure all deliveries are completed efficiently. * Adhere to all safety regulations and company policies during transit. * Provide excellent customer service to clients upon delivery.

a5131d3cd95c45df.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن فني جودة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان التزام المنتجات بمعايير الجودة من خلال جمع العينات وفحصها وتحليلها، بالإضافة إلى مراجعة سياسات وإجراءات الجودة ومراقبتها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع عينات التصنيع من مختلف مراحل عملية الإنتاج، بما في ذلك المنتجات قيد التصنيع والمنتجات النهائية. إجراء الفحوصات اللازمة لعينات المنتجات، والتحقق من مدى التزامها بمعايير الجودة المطلوبة. توثيق النتائج التي يتم التوصل إليها من عمليات الفحص والتحليل بدقة. تحديد مصادر العيوب المحتملة في المنتجات أو العمليات. وضع التوصيات المناسبة للتخفيف من آثار العيوب وتحسين الجودة. تحديث سياسات وإجراءات الجودة بشكل مستمر لضمان فعاليتها ومواكبتها للمتطلبات. الحفاظ على الخبرات الفنية وتحديث المعرفة المتعلقة باتجاهات القطاع واللوائح الحكومية ذات الصلة بالجودة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال فحص الجودة أو دور مماثل. القدرة على جمع العينات وفحصها وتحليلها بدقة. فهم جيد لسياسات وإجراءات مراقبة الجودة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

a533c3773a4816b6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ادارة الاعمال عن أخصائي اختبار اختراقات للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يتولى أخصائي اختبار الاختراقات مسؤولية تقييم واختبار أمن الأنظمة والشبكات والتطبيقات من خلال محاكاة الهجمات السيبرانية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى اكتشاف الثغرات الأمنية وتقديم توصيات لمعالجتها وتقليل المخاطر، مما يعزز مستوى الحماية السيبرانية في الجهة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية فهم وتحليل أنظمة الحاسب والشبكات والبنية التحتية ومتطلبات الأمن التقني. إجراء اختبارات اختراق عن بُعد للشبكات والتطبيقات والأنظمة. تخطيط وتصميم وتنفيذ سيناريوهات وأدوات اختبار الاختراق. إعداد تقارير دورية عن الثغرات ونقاط الضعف الأمنية المكتشفة. تقديم توصيات لمعالجة الثغرات وتقليل المخاطر الأمنية. إعداد تقارير شاملة تتضمن نتائج الاختبارات والتحليل والتوصيات. استخدام التفكير الإبداعي والاستراتيجي لمحاكاة الهجمات واكتشاف الثغرات. تطبيق منهجيات اختبار الاختراق المعتمدة مثل PTES وOSSTMM وNIST وOWASP. تطوير وتنفيذ خطط إدارة التهديدات والثغرات لتقليل سطح الهجوم. تحليل التهديدات الناشئة ومتابعة مستجدات المشهد الأمني بشكل مستمر. مراجعة واستغلال الثغرات (Proof of Concept) لتحديد المخاطر وتطوير حلول التخفيف. المساهمة في تطوير نماذج التهديدات وفهم أساليب الهجوم والدفاع. استخدام وتصنيف الثغرات وفق معايير CVSS وCVE. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال اختبار الاختراقات أو الأمن السيبراني. فهم عميق لمفاهيم الأمن السيبراني ومنهجيات اختبار الاختراق. القدرة على تحليل الأنظمة المعقدة وتحديد نقاط الضعف. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على حل المشكلات. القدرة على إعداد تقارير فنية واضحة وشاملة. التفكير الإبداعي والاستراتيجي في محاكاة الهجمات. معرفة بمنهجيات PTES وOSSTMM وNIST وOWASP. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في تبوك، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل أخصائي اختبار الاختراقات ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تعزيز الأمن السيبراني للجهة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

a5cc06914badf77e.description: About the Internship Vallourec is seeking a Sourcing Intern to join its team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This internship is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience who are looking to develop a career in Procurement and Supply Chain. The role provides practical experience in strategic sourcing, supplier management, market research, and procurement operations, while supporting daily purchasing activities. Role Overview The Sourcing Intern will collaborate with experienced procurement professionals, assisting in supplier identification, quotation evaluation, cost analysis, and contributing to sourcing initiatives that align with operational and business objectives. This position is suitable for students or recent graduates aiming to enhance their commercial awareness, negotiation skills, and understanding of procurement best practices. Key Responsibilities Maintain updated purchasing records, data, and pricing within the system. Execute and monitor all regular purchasing duties. Coordinate with user departments and suppliers regarding purchasing scope for assigned projects. Assist in managing and following up on local and overseas orders. Handle and monitor claims to factories and vendors for defectives, shortages, or missing parts. Support relevant departments with quotations for tender purposes. Coordinate with suppliers to ensure on-time delivery. Prepare and process purchase orders and documents in accordance with company policies and procedures. Negotiate for optimal purchasing packages (quality, price, terms, delivery, and service) with assigned suppliers and sub-contractors. Purchase and issue orders according to specifications. Plan and manage inventory levels of materials or products. Source new parts, suppliers, or sub-contractors as needed. Monitor and coordinate deliveries of items with local and overseas suppliers. Accountabilities Source, select, and negotiate for the best purchase package in terms of quality, price, terms, deliveries, and services with suppliers. Monitor and coordinate deliveries of items between suppliers to ensure timely delivery to site/store. Manage vendor registration and modification of bank data for ME entities. Required Qualifications Familiarity with standard concepts, practices, and procedures within a relevant field. Ability to rely on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals. General computer literacy. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this internship opportunity with Vallourec.

a53afa0714d9e77e.description: فرصة تعاون لمندوبي ومهندسي المبيعات الميدانية – الرياض هل تعمل في بيع الأجهزة أو المعدات أو المستلزمات الطبية، أو تجهيز العيادات والمجمعات، ولديك زيارات وعلاقات قائمة مع المنشآت الطبية؟ تبحث شركة كودلاينز عن شركاء مبيعات ميدانيين لتسويق «نظام إدارة طوابير الانتظار»، وإضافته إلى الحلول التي يعرضونها على عملائهم خلال زياراتهم المعتادة. يساعد النظام المنشآت على تنظيم استقبال العملاء وإدارة الانتظار، ويتيح: • تسجيل العملاء عبر موظف الاستقبال أو جهاز الخدمة الذاتية أو رمز QR. • عرض الأدوار والنداء عبر شاشة الانتظار. • إرسال تحديثات الدور عبر واتساب والرسائل النصية. • إدارة الفروع ومتابعة التقارير والإحصائيات. نستهدف أصحاب الخبرة في: • مبيعات الأجهزة والمعدات والمستلزمات الطبية. • تجهيز العيادات والمجمعات الطبية. • مبيعات أجهزة الأسنان والتجميل والجلدية. • مبيعات البرامج والحلول التقنية للمنشآت الطبية. نبحث عن شخص لديه علاقات مباشرة مع ملاك المنشآت أو مديريها أو مسؤولي التشغيل، ومهارة في عرض الحلول ومتابعة فرص البيع. آلية التعاون: تعاون مرن بعمولة على المبيعات وفق اتفاق واضح، ويمكن أن يكون إلى جانب نشاطك الحالي، بما يتوافق مع التزاماتك المهنية.

a55d91fbd29dc5c4.description: About the Role The E-Commerce & Omni-Channel Development Lead is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, within Abbott Nutrition International (ANI). This role is responsible for driving the growth of Abbott Nutrition's digital commerce business by developing and executing e-commerce and omni-channel strategies across various platforms and customer touchpoints. Role Purpose and Context The E-Commerce & Omni-Channel Development Lead will focus on achieving sustainable growth for Abbott's Nutrition portfolio. This involves enhancing digital shelf excellence, improving online shopper engagement, optimizing customer journeys, and creating seamless omni-channel experiences. The role supports both healthcare professional recommendations and consumer purchasing behavior, ensuring compliance with company and healthcare regulations. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute Abbott Nutrition's e-commerce and omni-channel growth strategy to meet business objectives, including annual sales, market share, and profitability targets across digital channels. Identify growth opportunities across pure-play e-commerce, pharmacy e-commerce, marketplaces, quick commerce, and omni-retail customers. Build joint business plans with key e-commerce partners to accelerate category and brand growth. Lead the development of seamless consumer and shopper experiences across online and offline channels, driving omni-channel initiatives that connect healthcare professional engagement, retail activation, pharmacy recommendations, and digital conversion. Ensure best-in-class product content across all digital platforms and improve product discoverability through search optimization, category placement, content enhancement, and digital merchandising. Monitor digital shelf KPIs, including availability, content compliance, search rankings, ratings & reviews, and share of search, establishing governance and execution standards across all e-commerce partners. Collaborate with Marketing and Trade Marketing teams to develop digital-first activation plans, driving online campaigns, media investments, and promotional activities to increase traffic and conversion. Monitor and analyze business performance across digital channels, developing dashboards and reports to track sales, market share, traffic, conversion, basket size, and ROI. Partner with Supply Chain & Distributors to ensure product availability and reduce out-of-stock occurrences, and work with Medical Affairs and Regulatory teams to ensure compliance of digital content. Key Performance Indicators Financial: E-commerce Net Sales Growth, Market Share Growth, Gross Profit Contribution, Revenue Delivery vs Plan. Commercial Excellence: Digital Shelf Compliance, Share of Search, Product Availability (OSA), Online Assortment Coverage. Consumer Metrics: Conversion Rate, Average Order Value, Repeat Purchase Rate, Customer Acquisition & Retention. Execution Metrics: Joint Business Plan Delivery, Promotional ROI, Customer Satisfaction, Omni-Channel Program Adoption. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant professional experience is required for this role. Work Environment This position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, and operates within Abbott Nutrition International (ANI). The role involves close collaboration with various internal teams including Sales, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Trade Marketing, Supply Chain, and Digital teams.

a5b7966582f3624d.description: About the Role DePuy Synthes is seeking a Sr. Manager, HCC Middle East to serve as the Healthcare Compliance Officer for the Middle East markets. This full-time position can be based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, or Dubai, UAE. The role provides strategic and operational healthcare compliance leadership for DePuy Synthes’ Orthopedics business, focusing on ethical business conduct, effective risk management, and adherence to applicable healthcare laws, regulations, and company policies. Role Context and Impact This position involves close collaboration with country and cluster leadership, Legal, business and functional stakeholders, and regional and global Compliance teams. The Sr. Manager, HCC Middle East plays a critical role in protecting the organization’s reputation while enabling compliant and sustainable business growth across the diverse and highly regulated Middle East region. Key Responsibilities Serve as the primary Healthcare Compliance Officer for Middle East markets. Lead the development and execution of healthcare compliance strategies aligned with global and regional priorities. Identify, assess, and manage compliance risks related to commercial, promotional, professional education, and other business and operational activities. Provide proactive, practical guidance to business leaders on healthcare compliance requirements and ethical decision-making. Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to embed effective compliance controls into business processes and go-to-market models. Oversee core compliance programs, including training, monitoring, risk assessments, and issue management activities across the region. Partner with Legal and other functions to support investigations, audits, and interactions with regulators or health authorities. Monitor regulatory developments and industry trends across the Middle East to anticipate and address emerging compliance risks. Prepare and present compliance risk assessments, insights, and recommendations to country, regional, and senior leadership. Foster a strong culture of integrity, accountability, and speak-up across the markets supported. Experience and Location Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. This role is based in Jeddah, Makkah, or Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, or Dubai, UAE. The position requires travel up to 20–30%, primarily within the Middle East, with some regional travel.

a5e3138cf1275775.description: About The Luxury Collection The Luxury Collection Hotels & Resorts operates over 120 properties across more than 35 countries, focusing on delivering authentic experiences that create lasting memories. With a history spanning over 100 years, originating from the Italian CIGA brand in 1906, the company continuously evolves to meet the expectations of luxury travelers. Each hotel and resort serves as a unique representation of its location, offering a gateway to the destination's cultural heritage. The Luxury Collection is part of Marriott International. Role Summary The Guest Experience Expert at The Luxury Collection in Jeddah, Makkah, is responsible for creating memorable and unique guest experiences beyond standard check-in and check-out procedures. This full-time role involves guiding guests throughout their stay by delivering a range of services. The position requires 0-1 years of experience and emphasizes proactive engagement to ensure guest satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Deliver a wide range of services to guide guests through their entire stay. Process operational needs and address guest requests efficiently. Complete necessary reports and documentation. Share information about local area highlights and attractions. Ensure all transactions contribute positively to the overall guest experience. Professional Standards and Requirements Maintain a safe work environment for all. Adhere to all company policies and procedures. Uphold confidentiality regarding company and guest information. Protect company assets and resources. Ensure consistent adherence to quality standards. Present a professional appearance, including uniform and personal grooming, and maintain professional communication. Physical Demands This role requires physical activity, including standing, sitting, or walking for extended periods. Guest Experience Experts will engage in hands-on tasks, which may involve moving, lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, and placing objects weighing up to 10 pounds without assistance. The ability to perform these duties effectively is essential for success in this position. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will have 0-1 years of experience and an appreciation for evocative storytelling, a keen interest in the destination's heritage, and a desire to deliver genuine, personalized, and anticipatory hospitality. This role is suited for individuals who are proactive and committed to delivering high standards of service within a luxury hotel environment.

a5f46c53344bc96b.description: About the Role sraco is seeking Fire Fighters to join their team, supporting operations with Saudi Aramco. This full-time position is open to Saudi Nationals with 0-1 years of experience in fire fighting. The role focuses on providing essential fire and emergency response services to ensure safety and efficient incident control within designated areas. Key Responsibilities Provide 24/7 fire emergency response at designated area fire stations, ensuring efficient and safe control of incidents. Perform complete fire and emergency services in accordance with the defined scope of work. Adhere to company general instructions, Fire Protection internal policies and programs, standard operating procedures, and all Saudi Aramco requirements. Regularly participate in scheduled proponent drills within the area. Contribute to the regular review and update of Emergency Response Planning. Ensure a constant state of readiness for all emergency response personnel and equipment. Maintain compliance with SA Standards for all fire safety aspects. Report all fire and emergency response activities in a timely and accurate manner. Qualifications and Requirements Saudi National. 0-1 years of experience in fire fighting. Possession of relevant fire fighting certifications. Application Process Candidates are required to attach their fire fighting certifications along with their CV when applying for this position.

a5ff4d9532bb29c2.description: About the Role Halliburton is seeking a Svc Operator I-L&P to join our team in Al Qatif or Al Khobar. This full-time position requires 0-1 years of experience and involves operating and maintaining well logging equipment for subsurface geological information recording. Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience. Responsibilities Rig up and rig down surface and downhole well logging equipment at work locations to record information about subsurface geologic formations. Operate well logging equipment at job sites. Assemble downhole well logging tools, including electric, nuclear, sonic, and other specialized tools. Maintain, clean, and perform preventative maintenance on both downhole and surface well logging equipment. Conduct pre and post-job vehicle and equipment inspections, completing associated paperwork and reports. Learn to operate pressure control equipment. Qualifications and Requirements Ability to communicate effectively with others, given the nature of oil field service work. Proficiency in basic mathematical calculations, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Basic reading comprehension and writing skills. Knowledge of HMS standards and guidelines for PSL personnel. Compliance and Safety Promote safety awareness and environmental consciousness. Comply with all applicable safety and environmental procedures and regulations. Ensure adherence to Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) regulations and guidelines. Actively participate in quality improvement processes. Impact of the Role Tasks performed correctly in this role indirectly contribute to cost containment, efficiency, profitability, and overall operations. Consequences of error are measurable and can be confined. Equal Opportunity Employer Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

a501cd2696c3799c.description: About the Role JAL International Co. Ltd. is seeking a Project Management Specialist to join their team in the Eastern region of Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience, providing support across various project phases to ensure timely and budget-compliant delivery. Role Overview The Project Management Specialist supports the planning, coordination, execution, monitoring, and reporting of projects. The primary objective is to ensure that all project activities are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with approved scope, quality standards, and company requirements. Key Responsibilities Support Project Managers in planning and executing projects from initiation through completion. Develop and maintain project schedules, action plans, milestones, and deliverables. Coordinate with internal departments, clients, contractors, consultants, and other stakeholders. Monitor project progress against approved schedules, budgets, scope, and objectives. Prepare and maintain project reports, dashboards, status updates, and presentations for management. Track project risks, issues, dependencies, and corrective actions, ensuring timely follow-up. Coordinate project meetings, prepare agendas and minutes, and follow up on assigned actions. Maintain accurate project documentation, records, approvals, and correspondence. Assist in monitoring project costs, resources, manpower, procurement, and contractual requirements. Support change management by tracking variations, scope changes, and their potential impact on cost and schedule. Ensure project activities comply with company policies, client requirements, applicable standards, and contractual obligations. Identify potential delays or challenges and coordinate with relevant teams to implement appropriate solutions. Support project close-out activities, including documentation, lessons learned, handover, and final reporting. Perform any other project-related duties assigned by management. Experience and Qualifications 0-1 years of experience in project management or a related field. Demonstrated ability to support project planning, execution, and monitoring. Proficiency in developing and maintaining project documentation. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Eastern region of Saudi Arabia, offering an opportunity to work within a structured project management framework at JAL International Co. Ltd. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

a5068004aea476a6.description: About the Internship Amazon Saudi Arabia is seeking an Area Manager Intern to join the University Talent Acquisition Team. This internship is designed for ambitious students to gain experience within Amazon Operations, one of the company's core businesses. The role is based in Riyadh and offers an opportunity to learn about leading and developing teams in a large-scale logistics environment. Role Overview As an Operations and Logistics Intern, you will observe and learn how managers engage teams to achieve their potential, ensure performance meets customer expectations, and foster a safe and productive environment. This role provides direct exposure to the operations within Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers, and Delivery Stations, placing you at the center of the customer order journey. Key Responsibilities Apply analytical skills to improve the functionality and service level of Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers, and Delivery Stations. Conduct deep dives into data, mapping processes and identifying problems. Propose, test, and implement effective solutions to operational challenges. Collaborate with managers, technology development teams, and front-line associates to address complex business and operational issues within Amazon's operations network. Internship Experience Interns will be matched with a mentor and will work on an impactful project. The program offers opportunities for personal and professional development through engagement with Amazonians, networking, and participation in activities with other interns. Interns are provided with the tools to manage their projects and gain real-world experience. Qualifications and Requirements Experience required: 0-1 years. Ability to commence an internship in Q2 2027. Availability for a full-time commitment (40 hours/week) for 3 to 6 months. Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia (field-based role). Career Progression Successful interns may be considered for a graduate role upon completion of their university studies.

a551d09d1bf1749c.description: About the Role Al-Futtaim is seeking a Talent Acquisition Partner specializing in Saudi National Retail to join the team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing the complete recruitment lifecycle for designated business units, focusing on strategic planning, sourcing, and assessment to meet manpower requirements. The position emphasizes high satisfaction levels for stakeholders and candidates, with success measured by adherence to SLAs, sourcing effectiveness, and quality of hire metrics. The role requires strong collaboration with internal teams and external candidates. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end recruitment processes for specific business units, ensuring satisfactory experiences for Hiring Managers, candidates, and stakeholders. Adhere to defined KPIs and SLAs in line with group standards and utilize established methodologies for each position. Support business units during manpower planning and scheduling, contributing to the Hiring Plan to fulfill budgeted manpower needs. Provide market insights during strategic planning stages to inform recruitment strategies. Manage sourcing solutions by understanding business needs and growth plans, developing extensive market networks for proactive manpower fulfillment. Cultivate relationships with external talent to build a proactive acquisition pipeline. Support business units with assessment tools for talent selection, recording and analyzing assessment activities to ensure merit-based recruitment. Facilitate feedback and review processes with new hires and managers. Efficiently utilize ATS systems, social media, and job boards. Plan and conduct assessment centers and open days for candidate selection, and develop Talent Pools to meet hiring plans and business needs. Manage job offers in line with manpower budgets and internal policies. Ensure adherence to SLAs and consistent process application for all roles, collaborating with business units to review and refine SLAs and recruitment processes. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in talent acquisition, particularly within the retail sector and with a focus on Saudi National recruitment. The role requires a strong understanding of recruitment processes and strategic sourcing. Required Skills Proficiency in managing full recruitment cycles. Strong strategic planning and sourcing capabilities. Ability to conduct effective candidate assessments. Experience with ATS systems, social media, and job boards. Excellent collaboration and communication skills. Analytical skills for reviewing performance and processes. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring close collaboration with various business units and external talent. The role operates without direct reports or financial management responsibilities. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

a5f7111ea549fe03.description: About the Role Astek Middle East is seeking a Senior Cost Controller to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on supporting financial monitoring, cost management, and performance reporting for energy efficiency, construction, infrastructure, and sustainability projects across Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing project budgets, analyzing cost performance, and providing financial information to aid project decision-making. Role Context and Objectives The Senior Cost Controller will play a key role in ensuring projects are delivered within approved budgets. This involves close collaboration with project managers, procurement, finance teams, contractors, and other stakeholders. The position requires a professional who can take ownership of project cost monitoring and reporting, providing accurate and timely financial insights. Key Responsibilities Monitor and control project costs against approved budgets and cost plans. Analyze cost variances and provide timely explanations and recommendations to project management. Prepare and maintain cost reports, budget forecasts, cash flow projections, and cost performance analyses. Track project commitments, expenditures, change orders, variations, claims, and other financial impacts. Coordinate with project managers, procurement, and finance teams to reconcile costs and ensure accurate financial reporting. Support the preparation of project cost estimates, budgets, and financial proposals for new and ongoing projects. Maintain project cost databases and ensure accurate coding and allocation of project expenditures. Prepare monthly cost reports and financial updates for project management and stakeholders. Monitor project financial performance and identify potential cost overruns or risks. Support project closeout activities, including final cost reporting and financial documentation. Identify cost-saving opportunities and provide recommendations to improve project financial performance. Support project teams with cost-related analysis and financial information throughout the project lifecycle. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in cost management. Strong analytical and financial skills. Demonstrated ability to take ownership of project cost monitoring and reporting. Candidates with significantly more experience who meet the technical and qualification requirements are also encouraged to apply. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working closely with various internal and external stakeholders to manage project finances effectively. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the outlined requirements are encouraged to apply for this position.

a55959d986f178de.description: About PepsiCo PepsiCo products are consumed over one billion times daily across more than 200 countries and territories. In 2021, PepsiCo generated over $79 billion in net revenue, driven by a portfolio of beverages and convenient foods including brands such as LAY’S®, DORITOS®, CHEETOS®, GATORADE®, PEPSI®, and QUAKER®. The company's vision is to be the global leader in beverages and convenient foods by winning with PepsiCo Positive (pep+), a strategic transformation focused on sustainability and human capital. PepsiCo fosters a dynamic culture driven by passionate teams that embrace new ideas. The company is committed to cultivating a diverse, collaborative, equitable, and inclusive environment where every individual's voice is valued. Job Summary PepsiCo is seeking a Production Operator for a full-time position in Dammam, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This role is responsible for the systematic and effective operation and monitoring of packaging lines and equipment to achieve production targets by maximizing line efficiency and minimizing packaging material waste. The Production Operator will ensure the production of quality products in line with business KPIs and maintain operational standards. Key Responsibilities Operate and monitor packaging lines and equipment to achieve production targets and maximize line efficiency. a5d3ba494584b3cc.description: Qiddiya has an opportunity for an Investment Management professional to join our team and play a pivotal role in evaluating, originating, and managing real estate investment opportunities.
